title: Aid
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a tiny strip of white cloth)
text | Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target’s hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration.
text | This spell can stack with temporary hit points and is especially effective before battle.
text | At Higher Levels. HP increase rises by 5 per slot level above 2nd.

title: Cure Wounds
contents: text | A creature you touch regains hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
text | The spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
text | At Higher Levels. Healing increases by 1d8 per level above 1st.

title: Guiding Bolt
contents: text | Make a ranged spell attack. On hit, the target takes 4d6 radiant damage and glows with divine light.
text | The next attack roll made against the target before your next turn has advantage.
text | At Higher Levels. Add 1d6 radiant damage per slot level above 1st.

title: Lesser Restoration
contents: text | Touch a creature and end one condition afflicting it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.
text | The spell provides immediate relief, useful during or between combats.

title: Light
contents: text | 3rd level Celestial Warlock Free Cantrip
text | ComponentsV, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)
text | Touch an object to make it shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.
text | The light can be any color and can be dismissed at will. Covering the object blocks the light.

title: Sacred Flame
contents: text | 3rd level Celestial Warlock Free Cantrip
text | A flame-like radiance descends on a target. It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage.
text | The target gains no benefit from cover against this spell.
text | Damage scales at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

title: Daylight
contents: text | A 60-foot radius sphere of light spreads from a point you choose. The light is bright and dispels darkness created by spells of 3rd level or lower.
text | If the spell is cast on an object, the light moves with it. It can be covered to block the light.

title: Revivify
contents: text | Touch a creature that died within the last 1 minute. The creature returns to life with 1 hit point.
text | The spell doesn’t restore missing body parts or remove fatal conditions like old age.

title: Guardian of Faith
contents: text | A spectral guardian appears and occupies a space. It deals 20 radiant damage (Dex save for half) to any hostile creature within 10 feet.
text | The guardian vanishes after dealing 60 damage total.

title: Wall of Fire
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (phosphorus or fire source)
text | You create a wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, 1 foot thick, or a ring of 20-foot diameter.
text | One side deals 5d8 fire damage to creatures within 10 feet. Creatures passing through take the same damage.
text | At Higher Levels. Increase damage by 1d8 per slot level above 4th.

title: Greater Restoration
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (diamond dust worth 100 gp)
text | Touch a creature to end one of the following effects: charmed, petrified, curses, ability score reduction, max HP reduction, or exhaustion level.
text | Requires expensive material component that is consumed.

title: Summon Celestial
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a golden reliquary worth 500 gp)
text | You summon a Celestial spirit in an unoccupied space. It uses either Avenger (melee) or Defender (tank) stat block.
text | The spirit acts on your initiative and obeys your commands.
text | At Higher Levels. Use higher CR stat block scaling with spell level.
